reply.thought: The user has provided a list of refunds reported by Alpha Co. I will list the refunds to see what the system has recorded for comparison, although the tool `list_refunds()` might just show the system's view. I will call `list_refunds()` first to check the reconciliation.

I have listed the orders and the refunds. The reported refunds match the refunds listed by the tool. Now I need to determine the net balance for each customer using `net_balance(customer)` for all unique customers identified from the orders: acme, birch, and cobalt. I will get the net balance for each customer sequentially.
I have the net balance for 'acme'. Now I need the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch'. Now I need the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balance for all three customers: acme (57275), birch (13323), and cobalt (58998).
